title: Trump says US in ‘final throes’ of Iran deal, Hormuz strait to open in days
summary: United States President Donald Trump has said that a deal between Israel and Iran is imminent, and that the two will leave each other alone for at least a week.

title: Red warning issued for fishermen as strong winds lash sea areas
summary: The Department of Meteorology has issued an urgent Red Warning for the maritime and fishing community, warning that wind speeds could increase up to 70 kmph in sea areas off the coast from Kankesanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar.

title: Cabinet approves drafting of Digital Economy Bill
summary: The Cabinet has approved a proposal to draft a Digital Economy Bill aimed at accelerating Sri Lanka’s digital transformation and promoting growth in the digital economy.

title: Sarana Gunawardena sentenced to 16 years of rigorous imprisonment
summary: Former Deputy Minister Sarana Gunawardena, who was found guilty in four corruption cases, was sentenced by Colombo High Court Judge Mohomed Mihal to four years’ imprisonment on each count.

title: Government to introduce demerit system for traffic offenses in September: Bimal
summary: The government is planning to introduce a demerit system for traffic offenses in September as a pilot project across the country, Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development Bimal Rathnayake said today.

title: Government railway season tickets go digital from July
summary: The issuance of concessionary railway season tickets for government officials will be fully digitized from July, allowing eligible public sector employees to obtain their tickets online through the Pravesha platform.

title: Over 200 stakeholders trained to put Sri Lanka’s Green Finance Taxonomy into practice
summary: More than 200 representatives from Sri Lanka’s financial sector, corporate institutions and public agencies have been trained on the practical implementation of the country’s Green Finance Taxonomy under a European Union-backed initiative aimed at accelerating sustainable investments.

title: LIVE: Sri Lanka A vs India A, 1st Match at Dambulla
summary: Sri Lanka’s chase of 278 got off to a positive start as openers Niroshan Dickwella and Avishka Fernando walked out to the middle.

title: Three die after restaurant fire near Thalawathugoda Junction
summary: All three victims who were injured following a fire at a restaurant near Thalawathugoda Junction have succumbed to their injuries, Police said.

title: Two fined Rs. 180,000 for killing protected barking deer
summary: A Nanu Oya court has imposed fines totaling Rs. 180,000 on two men arrested for killing and butchering a barking deer, a strictly protected species under Sri Lanka’s wildlife laws.

title: Sri Lanka sets 13% industrial emission cut as key step toward carbon neutrality by 2050
summary: Noting that the government has taken a landmark policy decision to double its emission reduction target for the industrial sector to a 13% commitment, authorities say this move forms the bedrock of Sri Lanka’s long-term climate strategy aimed at achieving 70% renewable energy generation by 2030 and complete carbon neutrality by 2050.

title: Ravi K questions Govt on IMF programme outcomes, future plans
summary: Opposition MP Ravi Karunanayake today sought clarification from the Government on the outcomes of Sri Lanka’s International Monetary Fund (IMF) programme and the country’s economic strategy beyond the current arrangement.

title: Central Bank records Rs. 332.38 buy, Rs. 342.08 sell
summary: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has issued the daily exchange rates for today (09), recording the buying price of the US dollar at Rs. 332.3805.

title: Sri Lankan workers to gain expanded job opportunities in Cyprus; social security issue to be resolved urgently
summary: Sri Lankan workers are set to receive expanded employment opportunities in Cyprus, while authorities have also moved to address long-standing concerns over social security benefits for retired migrant workers.

title: Trump says pilots safe after US Army Apache goes down near Hormuz
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said early on Tuesday that the pilots of a U.S. Army ‌Apache helicopter that went down near the Strait of Hormuz ’’are fine.’’
